card.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 Unable To Activate Issue

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 Unable To Activate Issue

symptoms: stuck at Hello screen after restore

claims.statement: An iPhone 7 restored with an existing board fault that then shows Unable to Activate has either a baseband fault or an NFC fault (reball or replace NFC_RF).

procedure: If baseband fine, reball or replace NFC_RF.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
